Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
URGENT: Online booking settings showing wrong providers

Patients are booking the wrong visit types online because all our providers are showing up for every schedule! I have a full waiting room right now and need to know how to restrict these booking options immediately before more wrong slots get taken.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "We understand how urgent this situation is, and a member of our support team is handling your request.

In the meantime, you may want to verify the online booking configuration:
1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules** and ensure the settings reflect your intended availability.
2. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, confirm that only the staff members who should accept online requests are designated.
3. Check each visit type in **Scheduling > Visit Types** and make sure the **Available Online** box is checked only for the appropriate visit types.
4. If a provider is still appearing for all schedules, verify that their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

If you need further assistance, our support team will continue to investigate this issue."
